cells.Resource: Maximum number of individual protected resources that you can specifically include in a protection group. In the API, this applies to the `Members` that you specify when you set the protection group `Pattern` to `ARBITRARY`. In the console, this applies to the resources that you select for the protection grouping **Choose from protected resources**.
